_about: Reference results for the two official USDA-ARS KINEROS2 sample runs (Samples.zip, readme 3/2002, sha256 4842737128bb1409fbd8d2eaa9f9e9e8f4b3c086dc34ca151e25c95eb950dc7c). Values are the ones printed by the gfortran build of KINEROS2 25-Oct-2019 (ARS-SWRC/KINEROS2 f0bbae2) on 2026-10-06 and cross-checked against the official ARS Windows k2_x64.exe under WINE (agreement to the 6th-7th significant digit). Source: KISSPATH_HOME/engine_builds_20261006/KINEROS2/BUILD_LOG.md.

tolerance.why: official k2_x64.exe vs gfortran build differ only in the 6th-7th digit (wg11 peak 668.4023 vs 668.4020 cfs; ex1 sediment 5.172343 vs 5.172339 t/ha); 1e-4 relative covers that, nothing more
